integrity: The arbitrary-dimensional statement is proved from the published adjacency model; finite breadth-first-search checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the coherent-path flip graph, not the full flip graph containing incoherent monotone paths.
The originality comparison cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent result stated purely as a graph theorem about a punctured ternary Cartesian product.
title: Exact flip-distance enumerator of cross-polytope coherent monotone paths
